queueIds.description: Instances with the 'queue.multi' feature: further queues of the same search. The player holds a ticket in queueId and in each of these; the first to reach a match prompt holds the others back, they close when its match starts and resume when it falls through. queue.leave and queue.update act on the whole search.

regions.description: Measured round trip to each relay region.

allowAiOpponent.description: "Allow an AI opponent": the queue may fill empty seats with AIs after its backfill delay. Default true.
